## Overview

LRPGF07b is a treated-only **gain-factors** model for CELF basic concepts (`celf`): what is associated with how much children gain across the three period transitions (ANCOVA - the period post-count given its pre-count - Beta-Binomial logit, child random intercept). It conditions on the own baseline, age, cognitive ability (block design), the upstream DAG skills receptive vocabulary (R) and taught receptive vocabulary (TR), with the age$\times$ability precision interaction. The specification is interaction-free in `trt` (#391 finding 3): the treatment$\times$ability and treatment$\times$own-baseline moderation questions live only in the full-cohort explicitly associational variant [LRPGF07m](../lrp-rli-gf-207/index.qmd).

_Causal labelling (DAG guardrails)._ Once restricted to on-intervention rows the treatment indicator is constant, so the treatment term is dropped: every coefficient here is an **adjusted association** among the treated (confounded by latent GA), never a treatment effect. Intervention sessions/dose are never conditioned on (a DAG collider). SES is excluded (not a DAG node; statistically redundant).

## Model

Beta-Binomial$(N, \mu\kappa, (1-\mu)\kappa)$ on the period post-count, $N = 18$, with
$\operatorname{logit}\mu = \alpha + \alpha_{\text{period}} + \gamma_{\text{own}}\operatorname{logit}_*(\text{pre}) + \gamma_A A_{\text{std}} + \gamma_{\text{ability}}z(\text{blocks}) + \sum_{s\in\{R,TR\}}\gamma_s\operatorname{logit}_*(s_{\text{pre}}) + \gamma_{\text{int}}\,(\text{age}\times\text{ability}) + u_{\text{child}}$. Priors: shared template in `priors.py`.
